info.name: Init

volume.tooltip: Speaker level (−∞…0 dB). 0 dB is unity. Default −3 dB. Old patches that stored 0…1 linear Volume are converted on load. Type a dB value (or −inf).

pan.tooltip: Stereo balance after Mono is summed in. 0 = unchanged (Mono to both). −1 = left only. +1 = right only.

seed.tooltip: Master seed for Randomize Phase and per-voice Random Steps jitter.

voices.tooltip: Number of PolyBLEP oscillators (max 64). Decimal like Additive: 12.5 → 13 oscillators with the last at half amplitude.

waveform.tooltip: soemdsp PolyBLEP shape for every oscillator. Pulse / Pulse Center / Trisaw use Morph as PWM.

morph.tooltip: PWM / width (0…1). 0.5 = center / 50%. Affects Trisaw, Pulse, and Pulse Center. Same bipolar rational −0.9 skew as PolyBLEP Morph (finer near center).

frequency.tooltip: Shared fundamental for every oscillator. Thru-zero: enable Bipolar on Frequency.

centerSide.tooltip: 0 = center voices only, 1 = side voices only. Face: red=left, green=center, blue=right.

jitterDistance.tooltip: Hypersaw Drift Amp — phase-modulation depth from the Random Steps walk. Mid skew at 0.1 for fine control near small distances. Scaled by oscillator frequency (|f|/100 Hz) so low and high notes keep the same temporal distance.

jitterSpeed.tooltip: Hypersaw Drift Jitter — Random Steps walk step size (Hz). 0 = no step energy.

jitterPitch.tooltip: Walk LPF cutoff as a semitone offset from the baked Hypersaw Drift Pitch (64.256). 0 = same as before this control existed. Lower ≈ freezes; higher = faster / more open. Overall motion without the stepped character of Jitter Speed.

distanceSlew.tooltip: How fast Jitter Distance / Vibrato Amp depth tracks Frequency (|f|/100 Hz compensation). 0 = instant (pitch changes leave frozen jitter unmoved). 8 ms = previous default. Higher = slower chase when you twist Frequency.

vibratoAmp.tooltip: HypersawUnit vibAmp — phaseOffset = phase × (vibOsc×Amp + PhaseMultiplier) + jitter. With Multiplier 1: scale swings around 1. Amp is distance-compensated (|f|/100 Hz) like Jitter Distance; Distance Slew sets how fast that tracks pitch. Center oscillator has no vibOsc feed in SoEm.

vibratoSpeed.tooltip: Base vibrato LFO rate (sine, phase offset 0.5).

vibratoFreqVary.tooltip: Per-voice vibrato rate spread (Master Seed). 0 = all at Vibrato Speed; 1 = each voice ±100% of Speed.

vibratoPhaseVary.tooltip: Per-voice vibrato LFO phase offset (Master Seed). 0 = all in phase; 1 = full random 0…1 offset (Hypersaw Vibrato Distribution spirit).

phase.tooltip: Global phase add on every voice (cycles). Also slides the face phase lines.

distributePhase.tooltip: Evenly spreads saws across phase. 1.0 = fully even 0…1.

randomizePhase.tooltip: Additional bipolar random phase offset per saw (scaled by amount).

phaseMultiplier.tooltip: HypersawUnit vibOffset — static term in phase×(LFO×Amp + Offset). Default 1 = distribute/random at unity when Vibrato Amp is 0. Hidden by default.

mode.tooltip: Real-pole stacks. LP / HP use High Cut / Low Cut. BP is HP then LP. Old LP6/BP6/HP6 values stay 0/1/2.

slope.tooltip: Cascaded real 1-poles. 6 dB = one pole; 24 dB = four. No resonance.

stagger.tooltip: Pole spread ratio k. 1 = same freq; ~1.5 gentle spread; above ~2.2 a stair-step. No effect at 6 dB.

lowFrequency.tooltip: Highpass cutoff (HP and BP). Sweep moves this with High Cut in musical steps.

highFrequency.tooltip: Lowpass cutoff (LP and BP). Sweep moves this with Low Cut in musical steps.

sweep.tooltip: Shift used cutoffs in semitones. BP keeps the Low/High interval (ratio) constant.

gainCompensation.tooltip: On = scale poles so the labeled cutoff is −3 dB. Off = every pole sits on the staggered freqs. No effect at 6 dB.

bpm.tooltip: Tempo in beats per minute. Also writes the patch Master Clock BPM.

pulseWidth.tooltip: Gate high duty of each cycle (0..1). 0.5 = square. Affects Gate 0-1 / Gate -1+1.

timeNumerator.tooltip: Numerator of Numer/Denom × whole note (same as Ping Pong). Numer=0 → no clock. 1/4 = one beat at BPM.

timeDenominator.tooltip: Denominator of Numer/Denom × whole note. At Numer=1: Denom 4=¼, 8=⅛, 16=1/16, 32=1/32.

timingMode.tooltip: Normal = Numer/Denom as written. Dotted = 1.5×. Triplet = 2/3× (three fit in two normals).

amplitude.tooltip: Output level for gate and trigger outs.

mode.tooltip: Lin = clamp Env to 0…1. Exp = classic VCA CV law (quiet lows, unity at 1) for Amplitude params.

voices.tooltip: Voice count when Playmode is Poly. Steal = oldest.

playmode.tooltip: Off = group only (no voice runner). Mono / Legato / Poly enable polyphony.

updateOnTrigger.tooltip: On (default): latch Attack/Release/Fall/Snap/Body depths/Amplitude on Gate rise. Feedback into Decay/Sustain stays live. Gate height at rise is velocity (env level + feedback) — soft Gate = less-high pluck.

attack.tooltip: Linear rise time. 0 = skip straight to decay (instant peak).

fallCurve.tooltip: Shape for Decay and Release. 0 ≈ linear; patch default ≈ +0.81.

decaySnap.tooltip: Patch feedback into Decay (atten ×0…1, inverted). 0 = short like the patch. 1 = long.

decayBody.tooltip: Feedback into Sustain (base forever 1.0). 0 = short like the patch. 1 = long hang.

release.tooltip: Extends the Decay Body after Snap (patch Release). Short Gate/Trigger: this is most of the tail. Longer = longer body.

loop.tooltip: On = retrigger from Sustain while gated (can sound like attack resets).

amplitude.tooltip: Final output trim. Gate height at rise sets env level (velocity) into Snap/Body feedback (× hardcoded 0.980691 → Range). Soft Gate = less-high pluck.

rate.tooltip: Clock rate in Hz. Wired ƒ cancels Rate (absolute Hz), same as oscillators.

duty.tooltip: Gate high time as a fraction of the period. Quantized to whole samples at the current rate.
